title: Whitney ball cover of the complement with bounded overlap and local finiteness
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let A ⊆ ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) be closed and nonempty. Write d(x) := Metric.infDist x A and r(x) := min{1, d(x)}/20. Then there exist a set J ⊆ ℝⁿ and N ∈ ℕ such that: (C1) J ⊆ ℝⁿ∖A; (C2) every x ∉ A has some s ∈ J with |x − s| ≤ 5r(s); (C3) for every x ∉ A, the set J(x) := {s ∈ J : |x − s| < 10r(s)} is finite and has at most N elements (Set.ncard J(x) ≤ N); (C4) for every x ∉ A, the set J'(x) := {s ∈ J : ∃ z ∈ ℝⁿ, |z − s| < 10r(s) and |z − x| < r(x)} is finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)), IsClosed A → A.Nonempty → ∃ (J : Set (Rn n)) (N : ℕ), J ⊆ Aᶜ ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ s ∈ J, ‖x - s‖ ≤ 5 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)) ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, Set.Finite {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ‖x - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)} ∧ Set.ncard {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ‖x - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)} ≤ N) ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, Set.Finite {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ∃ z : Rn n, ‖z - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20) ∧ ‖z - x‖ < min 1 (Metric.infDist x A) / 20})
